yrs.definition: Form of years (abbreviation): A very long time.

yuman.definition: Of or relating to a language family spoken by Native Americans in the southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico.

zest.definition: The outer skin of a citrus fruit, used as a flavouring or garnish.

zigzagged.definition: Form of zigzag (participle past): To move or to twist in a zigzag manner.

zip.definition: The high-pitched sound of a small object moving rapidly through air.
